fact: Eritrea's report for 2017-2020, dated September 2021, says the country has 54 police stations and 35 sub stations, only one of them (Kerkebet, Anseba Region) new since the first report submitted in 2016; it states nothing on how any of them record reports or cases.
title: Eritrea’s National Report (2017-2020) on The African Charter
publisher: The State of Eritrea, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
